indexing: sprite = kSpriteTypes[type].frames[frame]; SpriteDef{hotX,hotY,w,h,ptr,fileOffset}; pixels = w*h bytes at fileOffset in SPRITENW.DAT; loader remaps 0->255 (colour key) and 255->192

opcodes.<0x8000: FRAME n: select frame n of the type, end of tick
opcodes.0x8003: LOOP reg, ptr: if var[reg] != 0 { var[reg]--; goto ptr }
opcodes.0x8004: STEPDOWN reg, lo, hi, ptr: cur = frameIndex; if cur != var[reg] { setFrame(cur == lo ? hi : cur-1); goto ptr }
opcodes.0x8005: STEPUP reg, lo, hi, ptr: cur = frameIndex; if cur != var[reg] { setFrame(cur == hi ? lo : cur+1); goto ptr }
opcodes.0x8007: RANDOM reg, lo, hi: var[reg] = lo + rand() % (hi-lo+1)
opcodes.0x8009: WAIT n: timer = n, end of tick
opcodes.0x800a: WAITVAR reg: if var[reg] > 0 { timer = var[reg]; end of tick }
opcodes.other: unknown opcode (0x800b appears in the data): skipped, 1 word

palettes.layout: 0..9 windows static; 10..15 fixed6; 16..79 world[planetType]; 80..143 master (dialog64 inside XenoWinG picture windows); 144..245 fixed112; 246..255 windows static

phaseLists.settlement: combatA + world tileset (116+2*world, 117+2*world) + building sprite types (per-race for housing) + 145..172 per race
phaseLists.combat: combatA + combatB + building sprites of the battlefield + unit sprites (+race) + 399+unit / 395+unit + 404..407
